map.CAA 记录会阻断所有证书签发吗？: Do CAA records block all certificate issuance?
map.→ 去使用 CAA 记录生成器（免费 · 纯前端 · 数据不上传）: -> Go to the CAA record generator (free · pure front end · no data upload)
The sample "example.com. CAA 0 issue "letsencrypt.org"" lets only Let's Encrypt issue.
map.不影响已签发，仅约束未来签发。: Already issued certificates are unaffected; only future issuance is constrained.
map.勾选允许为该域签发的 CA: Tick to allow CAs to be issued for the domain
map.只阻断未被授权的 CA。CAA 是「白名单」而非黑名单：没有记录时任何 CA 都: It blocks only unauthorised CAs. CAA is a whitelist, not a blacklist: with no record any CA may issue; once an issue record is added only the listed CAs may issue. For monitoring, add an iodef record so CAs report unauthorised issuance attempts to the mailbox or URL you specify.
map.可勾选 Google、Let's Encrypt、DigiCert、Comodo: You can tick common CAs such as Google, Let's Encrypt, DigiCert and Comodo
map.可选填 iodef 邮箱，用于接收违规签发报告: Optionally fill in an iodef mailbox to receive unauthorised issuance reports
map.把生成的记录逐条添加到 DNS 解析，生效后用 dig 或在线检测确认: Add the generated records to the DNS zone one by one, then confirm with dig or an online checker once they take effect
map.支持设置签发标志（0 普通 / 128 关键）与 iodef 报告邮箱: Supports setting the issuance flags (0 normal / 128 critical) and the iodef report mailbox
map.生成限制证书颁发机构的 DNS CAA 记录: Generate the DNS CAA record that restricts the issuing certificate authorities
map.结果可直接粘进 DNS 解析面板: The result can be pasted straight into the DNS zone panel
map.证书签发前自检：上线前生成一条 issue 记录限定只允许自家 CA，配合 is: Self-check before certificate issuance: before going live, generate an issue record allowing only your own CA, and combine it with issuewild to restrict wildcard certificates, reducing the risk of a subdomain being fraudulently signed.
map.选择签发标志：一般选 0；选 128 表示 CA 不支持时必须拒绝签发: Choose the issuance flag: normally 0; 128 means issuance must be refused if the CA does not support it
map.限制哪些 CA 可签发本域证书，防误签发。: Restricts which CAs may issue certificates for this domain, preventing mistaken issuance.
